items.summary: FOR_AGENTS.md is this page written for you — what the store does for an agent, how to install it, how to call it, and where it stops being useful. CJK-first retrieval, no model in the core path, and evidence instead of confidence scores. pip install "Brain4Agent[precise]" needs Python 3.11+, plus a 20 MB optional dictionary. An agent working on a codebase accumulates context: why a decision was made, which approach failed, where a deployment lives. Brain4Agent stores those turns in one SQLite file and retrieves them by session.

items.summary: A background second screen for any phone agent. 中文 · English Agent-VScreen opens and drives other apps on an invisible virtual display, so your own screen stays yours. All you see is a small floating window showing what the AI is doing, which you can take over or stop at any moment. Any agent on the phone can use it: agents with a terminal use the vscreen CLI, agents that speak MCP use MCP, and your own code can use plain HTTP. Left: an agent solves sudoku in Chrome on the background screen (8x speed).
